claims.statement: For a rank <=5 symmetric physical-bank core L with s3(L)>=sigma and max range leverage <=1/320, plus any diagonal twist and arbitrary outside coefficients, the full product-law quadratic form has a continuous density with norm <=96 sqrt(e)/(7 sigma).

If the same low-rank core is perturbed by a retained symmetric E with op norm eta<(7/16)sigma, a physical cut has s3 >=kappa=(7/16)sigma-eta; either Theorem D pays by 6 sqrt(e)/kappa or one physical row carries >kappa^6/2 actual squared 3x3 cross-minor mass.

In account03/B19 r36 carrier branch I, either density <570.603 with continuity, or skeleton range leverage >1/320, or a same-bank internal physical cut has Frobenius square >=6.102770589677675e-5, or an actual physical row carries >1.35756060781355e-11 of 3-volume mass.

Conditioning the hub in account02/B19 r35, its fully in-plane rank-three union leaf block satisfies the new paving theorem and yields density <=96 sqrt(e)/7=22.6110345696, uniformly over arbitrary cap-one product laws; continuity follows from the uniform D3 Fourier envelope.
